descriptionChirho: The pomegranate fruit, whether literal (eaten, yielding juice/wine) or as a decorative motif on priestly garments and temple pillars; all singular, plural, construct, and suffixed inflections referring to the fruit itself.
The pomegranate tree as a plant or crop; distinguished in Spanish (granado vs granada), Korean (석류나무 vs 석류), and Hindi (अनार-के-पेड़), referring to the tree rather than its fruit.
